overview: The City Council and Community Development Board met in a joint session to approve a zoning update schedule and discuss proposed amendments for Medford Square, specifically regarding parking, historic preservation, and building dimensions.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the records of the special joint meeting held on January 21, 2026.

items.title: Proposed Zoning Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Approved a tentative schedule for zoning updates and public information sessions through May 2026 to provide clarity for consultants and the public.

items.title: Medford Square Zoning Amendments Hearing
items.summary: Continued the public hearing on Medford Square zoning with presentations on proposed use tables, dimensional standards, and strategies for protecting historic assets while encouraging density.

items.title: Public Comment and Correspondence
items.summary: The body heard feedback from the Chamber of Commerce and residents regarding parking mandates, the impact of new zoning on small businesses, and the preservation of historic architecture.

items.title: Guidance to Zoning Consultant
items.summary: Approved a motion directing Innis Land Group to revise the Medford Square proposal with options for parking flexibility, historic preservation incentives, arts use changes, and updated definitions for high-frequency transit.

items.title: Transom Project Update
items.summary: Staff provided an update on a planned zoning overlay for the Transom development parcels to facilitate a grocery store and parking for the senior center.
